names.note: The calendar’s own name page for him, which day-candidates.mjs prints as `name: Святитель Аркадий (Остальский), епископ Бежецкий, сщмч.`; the rank words, the grade and the see are stripped and the surname kept, the day line itself declining the forename and the see. `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE, fourteen `arcadius-*` and `arkadios-*` folders standing beside him.

birth.note: The reading at `/Life/life4761.htm`: «родился в апреле 1888 года в селе Яковицы Житомирской губернии в семье священника Иосифа Остальского». The month is given and the day is not.

death.note: The day line closes «(1937)» and the reading dates the shooting «16 (29) декабря 1937 года», the Julian day of this memory with its civil equivalent beside it, at the NKVD range at Butovo outside Moscow, where he was buried in a common grave.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 16 декабря ст. ст. — «Сщмчч. Аркадия, еп. Бежецкого, Илии, Павла, Феодосия, Владимира, Александра пресвитеров, прмч. Макария (1937).»

attestations.note: The first of the seven men of the day’s seventh line, read at `/Life/life4761.htm`. THE SEE DISAGREES AND BOTH READINGS ARE RECORDED: the day line and the name page call him bishop of Bezhetsk, while the reading’s own title calls him bishop of Lubny and vicar of Poltava; the man is the same, Остальский Аркадий Иосифович, and the office here is the bare `Bishop`, the sees being in the life because neither is a string the four locale packs read. NO `related` ROWS JOIN THE SEVEN MEN OF THIS LINE: six readings stand behind it, each has its own man arrested in his own district and sentenced by a troika of his own on 27 декабря, and this one alone was shot near Moscow and not in the Tver country; the source nowhere says they suffered together, so sharing a line is not made into a relation here. No folder held him. `new-martyr` is written as this corpus writes it for this calendar’s twentieth-century «сщмч.» entries, AND THE 26 ЯНВАРЯ SYNAXIS PAGE WAS NOT OPENED; his «Дни памяти» line also prints «8 июня (Петерб.)», a diocesan synaxis the day page does not repeat and which is therefore no feast of this folder’s.
